description: Test suite for email batching notification handling in Mattermost, including notification queuing, timing, user preferences, and ordering.

methods.name: TestHandleNewNotifications
methods.description: Tests the queuing and ordering of new notifications in the email batching job.

methods.name: TestCheckPendingNotifications
methods.description: Tests the logic for checking and sending pending notifications based on user activity and timing.

methods.name: TestCheckPendingNotificationsDefaultInterval
methods.description: Verifies default email batch interval for users without explicit preferences.

methods.name: TestCheckPendingNotificationsCantParseInterval
methods.description: Verifies fallback to default interval when user preference value is invalid.
